title: retry.sh check-suite rollup: GitHub-managed dynamic runs are excluded before pending and retry-budget checks
answers: Why are Copilot PR retries skipped even though the CI looks finished?
Why does a Copilot code review run block the scheduled CI retry for a PR?
Where are dynamic workflow runs filtered out of the retry decision in retry.sh?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/retry.sh (the paginated GraphQL check-suite query and the jq `suites` rollup) collects check suites for one commit SHA; every pending or failed decision is based on that rollup.
Rule: Drop runs whose workflowRun.event is "dynamic" in the suites select, before any status or conclusion check. GitHub-managed dynamic runs (Copilot coding-agent and Copilot review) use the same github-actions app as normal CI, so they must not count as pending or as retryable failures.
Symptom: A Copilot PR was never retried because a pending Copilot review or coding-agent run looked like in-progress CI, or a failed dynamic run was rerun on every scheduled attempt and failed each time.
Constraints: Only github-actions app runs in the rollup are affected; ordinary pending workflow runs still block retries. Verified that pending and failed dynamic runs are ignored while other pending checks still skip the commit.
applies: Scope: check-suite selection in .github/workflows/retry.sh; not the Protect workflow's own handling of dynamic runs.
says: Pull request automated retries are stalled because Copilot code review checks appear stuck in progress.
Scheduled test retries keep repeatedly triggering on failed Copilot agent runs.
Ensure pending Copilot review runs do not prevent automated retries of failed pull request checks.
Our pull request checks never automatically retry after normal build failures when Copilot is active.
search: Filtering check suites in .github/workflows/retry.sh requires dropping workflow runs where workflowRun.event is dynamic before checking status, conclusions, or retry budgets. This prevents GitHub-managed dynamic runs from Copilot coding-agent and Copilot review from being treated as pending CI or retryable failures in the jq suites rollup. The rule applies exclusively to github-actions app runs in the retry script check-suite rollup, while ordinary pending workflows continue to block retries.
